fusions.name: Lunge From the Shallows
fusions.desc: Lunges at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that is at or below 25% health and deals 22 piercing damage, rising to 1.5 times that at 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Rolling Thrash
fusions.desc: Thrashes in a circle, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, knocking them 2.5 tiles back and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: After a 0.5 second cast, holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Still Water Strike
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. You gain 5% dodge chance.
